points.reason: The process exposes rs1_i or zero through res_o and its valid and condition tests can select an incorrect value or withhold the useful result.
The condition signal controls whether the process assigns rs1_i or zero, so changing it can corrupt or suppress res_o, but it does not itself expose the result.
The decoded valid_cmd signal gates the result assignment, allowing an altered command decode to produce zero instead of the intended result.
The comparison reduces rs2_i to a zero-test that reveals information about the operand and changes the downstream result decision when the operand is altered.
The XNOR-derived condition reveals the tested operand property through the result path and controls whether the operand-dependent result is delivered or replaced by zero.
The clocked output choice between rs1_i and zero exposes the condition derived from rs2_i and can corrupt or suppress the operation when that condition is changed.
condition is the computed decision, and its value both affects the observable result choice and determines whether rs1_i is passed or zero is returned.
rs2_zero contributes directly to the XNOR decision, so its value can reveal and alter the condition that controls result delivery.
The result output reveals the decision through the rs1_i-versus-zero choice, while the same decision can cause an incorrect or unavailable result.
The instruction-control fields determine valid_cmd, so altering the decode can falsely assert or suppress the valid status.
valid_o is the direct status output, so forcing or withholding its copied valid_cmd value can make the surrounding processor accept or miss the operation.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: res_o stores and returns the conditional operation result at the unit boundary. It is the output port through which the complete result crosses the unit boundary.
structural assets.functionality: res_o stores and returns the conditional operation result at the unit boundary.
structural assets.justification: It is the output port through which the complete result crosses the unit boundary.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: rs1_i supplies the operand value that becomes the result when the command and condition are true. The complete operand crosses the unit boundary at this input port and is copied into res_o.
structural assets.functionality: rs1_i supplies the operand value that becomes the result when the command and condition are true.
structural assets.justification: The complete operand crosses the unit boundary at this input port and is copied into res_o.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: condition selects whether res_o receives rs1_i or zero. Its test directly decides the assignment that releases or suppresses the result.
structural assets.functionality: condition selects whether res_o receives rs1_i or zero.
structural assets.justification: Its test directly decides the assignment that releases or suppresses the result.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: valid_cmd enables the clocked result transfer for the decoded conditional operation. It decides whether the result assignment takes the operand path or the zero path.
structural assets.functionality: valid_cmd enables the clocked result transfer for the decoded conditional operation.
structural assets.justification: It decides whether the result assignment takes the operand path or the zero path.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: clk_i paces the update of res_o. Blocking the clock can stall delivery of the result.
structural assets.functionality: clk_i paces the update of res_o.
structural assets.justification: Blocking the clock can stall delivery of the result.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: rstn_i can reset res_o to zero. As the reset partner of the result output, it can clear the result and prevent its useful availability.
structural assets.functionality: rstn_i can reset res_o to zero.
structural assets.justification: As the reset partner of the result output, it can clear the result and prevent its useful availability.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: rs2_i crosses into the unit as the complete condition operand. The raw operand enters through this non-record input port and is the value from which the condition test is derived.
structural assets.functionality: rs2_i crosses into the unit as the complete condition operand.
structural assets.justification: The raw operand enters through this non-record input port and is the value from which the condition test is derived.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: rs2_zero carries the zero-test result derived from rs2_i. It is a derived predicate that can reveal information about the primary operand.
structural assets.functionality: rs2_zero carries the zero-test result derived from rs2_i.
structural assets.justification: It is a derived predicate that can reveal information about the primary operand.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: condition carries the predicate formed from the rs2_i zero-test and the instruction condition bit. The derived predicate can disclose a property of the primary operand through its value and effect.
structural assets.functionality: condition carries the predicate formed from the rs2_i zero-test and the instruction condition bit.
structural assets.justification: The derived predicate can disclose a property of the primary operand through its value and effect.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: res_o exposes the result choice controlled by the predicate derived from rs2_i. The output can reveal the operand's tested property through whether rs1_i or zero is returned.
structural assets.functionality: res_o exposes the result choice controlled by the predicate derived from rs2_i.
structural assets.justification: The output can reveal the operand's tested property through whether rs1_i or zero is returned.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: condition computes the conditional execution decision. It is the internal element where the decision is computed and where the result-selection decision is made.
structural assets.functionality: condition computes the conditional execution decision.
structural assets.justification: It is the internal element where the decision is computed and where the result-selection decision is made.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: ctrl_i carries the instruction condition-select field used to form the decision. The control-record input crosses the boundary with a field of this conceptual asset, so the whole record port is the boundary primary.
structural assets.functionality: ctrl_i carries the instruction condition-select field used to form the decision.
structural assets.justification: The control-record input crosses the boundary with a field of this conceptual asset, so the whole record port is the boundary primary.

structural assets.label: secondary

structural assets.functionality: rs2_i supplies the operand whose zero comparison contributes to condition.
structural assets.justification: Changing this input changes the predicate feeding the primary decision and can therefore alter or suppress the selected result.

structural assets.label: secondary

structural assets.justification: It directly influences the computation of the primary decision.

structural assets.functionality: res_o exposes the effect of condition through the selected result value.
structural assets.justification: The output can leak the primary decision by returning rs1_i for one decision and zero for the other.

structural assets.label: primary
